alignments.note: Anarthrous Niphal participle used substantivally; the supplied 'He that' joins the substantive's unit under rule 46, and the reflexive 'himself' realizes the Niphal voice under rule 44. Head on the lexeme-bearing 'separateth' under rule 46.

Supplied possessive with no suffix or other possessive morpheme in the clause; added under rule 18's closing sentence, one unit under rule 2 since the two words stand together and do one office. ASV italics corroborate without deciding (rule 7).
The ASV recasts the clause as 'seeketh his own desire', spending no English word on the preposition's own relation; unrepresented under rule 40.
No conjunction morpheme stands in this verse, so the coordinating 'And' answers to nothing and is added under rule 14's closing sentences.
Finite verb. The margin's 'Or, quarrelleth with' is read and set aside; the printed text governs (rule 38).

One substantive rendered by a two-word phrase; rule 31's subtraction heads it on 'sound', since 'wisdom' alone is any wisdom and the ASV does not write it alone for this word. The competing reading, heading on 'wisdom' as the class noun, was available (rule 8).

review_notes: No waw stands anywhere in the verse, so the ASV's 'And' is added rather than a connective's.
